title: COVID Broke the GTA New Condo Market. What Rises From the Ashes Will Look Very Different
summary:
Throughout October UrbanToronto is featuring a special State of Housing 2026 editorial series to examine the pressing housing challenges facing Toronto and the Greater Golden Horseshoe.

* * *

For years, Toronto’s new condominium market ran on a simple assumption: buy before construction, wait, and watch the value rise. That assumption survived recessions, policy changes, and countless warnings about oversupply. It did not survive the aftermath of COVID.
